## Storage types
Soroban has three storage types: temporary, persistent, and instance. Each type has its own TTL and fee profile.

## Agenda
The protocol meeting discussed Soroban storage fees and state archival.
Choose persistent storage for data that must outlive a ledger window. Soroban charges rent for every storage entry.

## Run the tests
The test calls `increment` three times and checks the stored counter.

## Overview
Soroban tokens keep balances in contract storage. See [how to issue an asset](how-to-issue-an-asset).

## getLedgerEntries
Read the current value of Soroban storage entries directly from the ledger.

## Contract commands
`stellar contract read` prints Soroban contract storage entries.
